name: kraken-360
description: Read-only access to your company's Kraken 360° data: see its tables, read their documentation and run read-only queries.

interface.shortDescription: Ask how your business is doing
interface.longDescription:
Ask ChatGPT how your business is doing and get answers from your company's data in Kraken 360°. How much did we sell this month compared with the same month last year? Which branches and salespeople are above their target? Who are our best customers, and which ones stopped buying? Which product lines leave the most margin?

Ask your questions the way you would ask an analyst, with no formulas or reports to build. ChatGPT finds the information, does the calculations and explains the result, and you can keep asking to dig deeper or compare. What you can ask about depends on the Kraken 360° modules your company has enabled.

Access is read-only: the connector cannot change your data, and each company sees only its own. You sign in with your Kraken 360° account.

How it works: ChatGPT sees which tables your company has in Kraken 360°, reads Octos's documentation for each one (what it holds, how the tables relate and how business metrics are defined) and runs read-only queries on them.

Keep in mind: ChatGPT can misread a question or build a query incorrectly. Check any figure against your Kraken 360° reports before making a decision with it; your reports remain the official source of your data.

Support: soporte@octos.gt or WhatsApp +502 2490-2078.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_tables and lists the returned gold_ai tables (e.g. ventas, cliente, producto), stating the as-of date from the metadata list_tables returns. Invents no tables.
positive.description: The reviewer account (credentials in Review details) signs in to the demo tenant: synthetic data for one Guatemalan wholesale distributor. ventas has sales every month from January 2023 to the cut-off date that every tool returns in its metadata; the data is rebuilt nightly, so the cut-off moves forward. Amounts come in GTQ (local) and USD (global); the company's convention is sales excluding IVA. Tests listing the tenant's tables.
positive.prompt: What tables are available in my Kraken 360° data?

positive.expected_behavior: Calls describe_schema (required) and summarizes the enabled modules and the metrics the returned catalogue defines, using only returned content. It may also call run_query (optional, read-only) to illustrate a metric; if it does, it names the currency and states that amounts exclude IVA.

Amounts come in GTQ (local) and USD (global); the company's convention is sales excluding IVA. Tests reading the documentation and metric catalogue.

Amounts come in GTQ (local) and USD (global); the company's convention is sales excluding IVA. Tests reading one table's documentation.

Returns one total per month with its currency named (GTQ or USD) and the change between months, excluding IVA. Draws the comparison only from the returned rows.

negative.expected_behavior: Does not delete or change anything and does not claim any record was changed. It may look up matching records read-only, then explains that Kraken 360° access is read-only.

es-419.description:
Pregúntale a ChatGPT cómo va tu negocio y obtén respuestas con los datos de tu empresa en Kraken 360°. ¿Cuánto vendimos este mes frente al mismo mes del año pasado? ¿Qué sucursales y vendedores van por encima de su meta? ¿Quiénes son nuestros mejores clientes y cuáles dejaron de comprar? ¿Qué líneas de producto dejan más margen?

Haz tus preguntas como se las harías a un analista, sin fórmulas ni reportes que armar. ChatGPT busca la información, hace los cálculos y te explica el resultado, y puedes seguir preguntando para profundizar o comparar. Lo que puedes consultar depende de los módulos de Kraken 360° que tu empresa tiene habilitados.

El acceso es únicamente de lectura: el conector no puede modificar tus datos, y cada empresa ve solo los suyos. Inicias sesión con tu cuenta de Kraken 360°.

Cómo funciona: ChatGPT ve qué tablas tiene tu empresa en Kraken 360°, lee la documentación de Octos sobre cada una (qué contiene, cómo se relacionan y cómo se definen las métricas del negocio) y hace consultas de lectura sobre ellas.

Ten en cuenta: ChatGPT puede equivocarse al interpretar una pregunta o al armar una consulta. Verifica en tus reportes de Kraken 360° cualquier cifra antes de tomar una decisión con ella; tus reportes siguen siendo la fuente oficial de tus datos.

Soporte: soporte@octos.gt o WhatsApp +502 2490-2078.
